sources.text:
Nestling by the Urho Kekkonen National Park, the primary objective of the Sompio Strict Nature Reserve is to preserve forest, fell and mire nature for the future and for scientific research.

Roaming within the strict Nature Reserve area is prohibited at all times of the year except on marked hiking trails.

In Sompio Strict Nature Reserve has a wide variety of habitat types. Nattastunturit Fells' bare tops and birch areas are lined with spruces and dry Riestonaapa aapa mire strips.
